verdict.rationale: Plaid Identity Verification is a KYC/identity-verification SaaS, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it so it can call their tools is a category error for this kind of product. The documented official MCP server (plaid-idv-probe-4) is the server role, where Plaid exposes tools to agents, so it does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
